description: Simulate an EVM transaction (or a sequence of up to 5, e.g. approve then swap) before signing: revert check with reason, every asset leaving or entering the wallet, approvals granted, sanctions/scam screening of counterparties, and a proceed/caution/avoid verdict. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.
name: tx_simulate
